p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(out),len(out[0])
    # Divider and non-background object are moved together to the divider; an 8 barrier is placed on the far edge.
    d=next((r for r,row in enumerate(out) if all(v==2 for v in row)),None)
    if d is not None:
        cells=[(r,c,out[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if out[r][c] not in (1,2)]
        if cells:
            top=min(r for r,c,v in cells); bot=max(r for r,c,v in cells)
            rows=[[out[r][c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(top,bot+1)]
            # Clear original object, move toward divider
            for r,c,v in cells: out[r][c]=1
            length=len(rows); nt=d-length
            if top>d: nt=d+1
            # use the closest valid placement on the opposite side
            if top<d: nt=d-length
            else: nt=d+1
            if nt>=0 and nt+length<=h:
                for i,row in enumerate(rows): out[nt+i]=row[:]
                barrier=nt-1 if nt<d else nt+length
                if 0<=barrier<h: out[barrier]=[8]*w
    else:
        # vertical divider: place object adjacent to divider and barrier along its far edge
        d=next(c for c in range(w) if all(out[r][c]==2 for r in range(h)))
        cells=[(r,c,out[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if out[r][c] not in (0,2)]
        if cells:
            left=min(c for r,c,v in cells); right=max(c for r,c,v in cells)
            width=right-left+1
            obj=[[out[r][c] for c in range(left,right+1)] for r in range(h)]
            for r,c,v in cells: out[r][c]=0
            nl=d-width
            for r in range(h): out[r][nl:nl+width]=obj[r]
            b=nl-1
            for r in range(h): out[r][b]=8
    return out
''')

code='''def transform(grid):
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]; h,w=len(a),len(a[0])
    # Uniform full-length divider
    horizontal=next((r for r,row in enumerate(a) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]==2),None)
    if horizontal is not None:
        d=horizontal
        counts={}
        for r in range(h):
            for v in a[r]:
                if v!=2: counts[v]=counts.get(v,0)+1
        bg=max(counts,key=counts.get)
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if a[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
        if not pts:return a
        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
        block=[a[r][:] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
        for r,c in pts:a[r][c]=bg
        if r1<d: nr=d-(r1-r0+1)
        else: nr=d+1
        for i,row in enumerate(block): a[nr+i]=row
        br=nr-1 if nr<d else nr+(r1-r0+1)
        if 0<=br<h:a[br]=[8]*w
        return a
    d=next(c for c in range(w) if all(a[r][c]==2 for r in range(h)))
    counts={}
    for row in a:
        for v in row:
            if v!=2: counts[v]=counts.get(v,0)+1
    bg=max(counts,key=counts.get)
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if a[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
    if not pts:return a
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    block=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in a]
    for r,c in pts:a[r][c]=bg
    nc=d-(c1-c0+1)
    for r in range(h): a[r][nc:nc+(c1-c0+1)]=block[r]
    for r in range(h):a[r][nc-1]=8
    return a
'''
